name: Strength Foundations — 4 Weeks
description: Four weeks to a real strength habit for total beginners: three simple full-body workouts a week — squat, hinge, push, pull — with warm-ups, recovery walks, mobility, and the rest days that are the actual program. Start light, learn the moves, add a little each week, and retest on day 25. No gym-bro grind, no daily punishment. Works at a gym or at home with almost nothing.

0.title: Pick your 3 moves and set up your space
Book your 3 workout days this week in your calendar
Baseline: how many push-ups and squats in one clean set? Write it down.

1.title: Workout A — squat, push, row (light, learn the moves)
Warm up first: 5 min easy movement

2.title: Easy 20–30 min walk — recovery counts as training

5.title: Workout C — full body, light and controlled

6.title: Real rest. A short walk if you want — that's it.
Lay out clothes for the first workout next week

7.title: Workout A — add one set, a touch heavier

10.title: 15 min mobility + stretch the tight spots

12.title: Rest. You've trained six times — that's the habit forming.

13.title: Fun movement — bike, hike, sport, dance. It all counts.

16.title: Workout B — 3 working sets, add reps or a little load

17.title: 15 min mobility — keep the joints happy

18.title: Workout C — push the last set a little

19.title: Rest hard so you grow. Sleep is part of the program.

22.title: 30 min walk — notice how your body feels vs day 1

23.title: Workout B — beat one number from week 1

25.title: Workout C + retest: push-ups and squats in one set. Compare to day 0.

26.title: Rest. You built a base that wasn't there a month ago.

27.title: Plan the next 4 weeks: same moves, a bit more load — book the days
Write down your wins: what got easier?
